# Overview

This script generates all publication-quality tables and figures.

**Inputs:**
- `data/intermediate/04_h1_results.rds`
- `data/intermediate/04_h1_results_continuous.rds`
- `data/intermediate/04_h1_results_drop.rds`
- `data/intermediate/04_h1_results_prob.rds`
- `data/intermediate/05_h2_results.rds`
- `data/intermediate/05_h2_results_continuous.rds`
- `data/intermediate/05_h2_results_drop.rds`
- `data/intermediate/05_h2_results_prob.rds`
- `data/intermediate/06_heterogeneity_results.rds`
- `data/intermediate/06_heterogeneity_results_continuous.rds`
- `data/intermediate/06_heterogeneity_results_drop.rds`
- `data/intermediate/06_heterogeneity_results_prob.rds`
- `data/intermediate/02_cleaned_data.rds`

**Outputs:**
- Final publication tables (HTML, TeX, PNG)
- Final publication figures

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("00_setup.R")
```

# Load Results

```{r load}
# Load model results from previous scripts
results_h1 <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "04_h1_results.rds"))
results_h1_cont <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "04_h1_results_continuous.rds"))
results_h2 <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "05_h2_results.rds"))
results_h2_cont <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "05_h2_results_continuous.rds"))
results_het <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "06_heterogeneity_results.rds"))
results_het_cont <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "06_heterogeneity_results_continuous.rds"))

# Load drop variant results
results_h1_drop <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "04_h1_results_drop.rds"))
results_h2_drop <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "05_h2_results_drop.rds"))
results_het_drop <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "06_heterogeneity_results_drop.rds"))

# Load probabilistic variant results
results_h1_prob <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "04_h1_results_prob.rds"))
results_h2_prob <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "05_h2_results_prob.rds"))
results_het_prob <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "06_heterogeneity_results_prob.rds"))

# Load data for additional tables
data <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_INTERMEDIATE, "02_cleaned_data.rds"))

cat("Results loaded successfully.\n")
```

# Table 1: Main RDD Results

```{r table1}
rows_t1 <- tibble::tribble(
  ~term, ~row1, ~row2, ~row3, ~row4, ~row5, ~row6, ~row7,
  'State FEs', '-', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X',
  'Source FEs', '-', '-', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X',
  'Topic FEs', '-', '-', '-', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X'
)
attr(rows_t1, 'position') <- c(3, 4, 5)

note_t1 <- "All standard errors are clustered at the source level. Models 1-4 uses the optimal bandwidth. Model 5 uses a linear specification with the full set of articles. Model 6 omits Military Topics. Model 7 omits NATO allies."

table_1 <- modelsummary(
  list(
    "(1)" = results_h1$model1_opt,
    "(2)" = results_h1$model2_opt,
    "(3)" = results_h1$model3_opt,
    "(4)" = results_h1$model4_opt,
    "(5)" = results_h1$model1_full_linear,
    "(6)" = results_h1$model4_non_mil,
    "(7)" = results_h1$model4_non_nato
  ),
  output = "gt",
  fmt = 3,
  stars = c('*' = .05, '**' = .01, '***' = .001),
  coef_map = c("treatment" = "Invasion"),
  gof_omit = "BIC|AIC|RMSE|Std.Errors|FE",
  title = "Table 1: Effect of Russian Invasion on Media Sentiment (RDD) with Day Running Variable",
  add_rows = rows_t1,
  notes = str_wrap(note_t1, 80)
)

table_1

gtsave(table_1, file.path(FIGURES_TABLES, "table_1.html"))
```

# Table 2: Diff-in-Disc Results

```{r table2}
rows_t2 <- tibble::tribble(
  ~term, ~row1, ~row2, ~row3, ~row4, ~row5, ~row6,
  'State FEs', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X',
  'Source FEs', '-', '-', '-', '-', '-', '-',
  'Topic FEs', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X', 'X'
)
attr(rows_t2, 'position') <- c(5, 6, 7)

note_t2 <- "All standard errors are clustered at the source level. Model 2 uses the optimal bandwidth. Model 3 omits NATO allies. Model 4 omits military-related articles. Model 5 uses only Russian-related articles. Model 6 combines all robustness filters (non-NATO, non-military, Russian-related) with a re-optimized bandwidth."

table_2 <- modelsummary(
  list(
    "(1)" = results_h2$model2a,
    "(2)" = results_h2$model2a_opt,
    "(3)" = results_h2$model2d,
    "(4)" = results_h2$model2b,
    "(5)" = results_h2$model3a,
    "(6)" = results_h2$model3a_opt
  ),
  output = "gt",
  fmt = 3,
  stars = c('*' = .05, '**' = .01, '***' = .001),
  coef_map = c(
    "treatment" = "Invasion",
    "treatment:state_owned" = "State Owned x Treatment"
  ),
  gof_omit = "BIC|AIC|RMSE|Std.Errors|FE",
  title = "Table 2: Difference in Discontinuities Analysis",
  add_rows = rows_t2,
  notes = str_wrap(note_t2, 80)
)

table_2

gtsave(table_2, file.path(FIGURES_TABLES, "table_2.html"))
```

# Table 3: Heterogeneity by Russian Alignment

```{r table3}
note_t3 <- "All standard errors are clustered at the source level. Model 1 uses no fixed effects. Model 2 uses full data with topic fixed effects. Model 3 uses the optimal bandwidth with topic fixed effects. Model 4 omits military-related articles and uses a re-optimized bandwidth. Model 5 uses only Russian-related (non-military) articles with a re-optimized bandwidth. Sample restricted to state-owned media in non-NATO countries."

table_3 <- modelsummary(
  list(
    "(1)" = results_het$model5a,
    "(2)" = results_het$model5a_full,
    "(3)" = results_het$model5a_opt,
    "(4)" = results_het$model5a_opt_non_mil,
    "(5)" = results_het$model5a_opt_russian
  ),
  output = "gt",
  fmt = 3,
  stars = c('*' = .05, '**' = .01, '***' = .001),
  coef_map = c(
    "treatment" = "Invasion",
    "treatment:csto" = "CSTO x Treatment"
  ),
  gof_omit = "BIC|AIC|RMSE|Std.Errors|FE",
  title = "Table 3: Russian Alignment Heterogeneity (State Media)",
  notes = str_wrap(note_t3, 80)
)

table_3

gtsave(table_3, file.path(FIGURES_TABLES, "table_3.html"))
```

# Comparison Table: Countries by Alignment and Ethnic Population

```{r comparison-table}
get_group <- function(russian_group, security_group) {
  paste(intersect(russian_group, security_group), collapse = ", ")
}

table_data <- data.frame(
  `Ethnic Russian Population` = c("Low Ethnic", "High Ethnic"),
  `Low Russia Aligned` = c(
    get_group(LOW_RUSSIAN_POP, NEUTRAL_COUNTRIES),
    get_group(HIGH_RUSSIAN_POP, NEUTRAL_COUNTRIES)
  ),
  `High Russia Aligned` = c(
    get_group(LOW_RUSSIAN_POP, CSTO_COUNTRIES),
    get_group(HIGH_RUSSIAN_POP, CSTO_COUNTRIES)
  )
)

comparison_table <- table_data %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Ethnic Russian Population x Russia Security Alignment",
    subtitle = "Country Classification"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Ethnic.Russian.Population = "",
    Low.Russia.Aligned = "Low Alignment (Neutral)",
    High.Russia.Aligned = "High Alignment (CSTO)"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "all", color = "black", weight = px(1)),
    locations = cells_body()
  )

comparison_table

gtsave(comparison_table, file.path(FIGURES_TABLES, "comparison_table.html"))
```

# Export Tables to LaTeX

```{r latex-export}
# Function to save modelsummary as tex
save_tex <- function(models, filename, coef_map, title, rows = NULL, note = NULL) {
  modelsummary(
    models,
    output = file.path(FIGURES_TABLES, filename),
    fmt = 3,
    stars = c('*' = .05, '**' = .01, '***' = .001),
    coef_map = coef_map,
    gof_omit = "BIC|AIC|RMSE|Std.Errors|FE",
    title = title,
    add_rows = rows,
    notes = note
  )
}

# Note: These will generate .tex files for LaTeX inclusion
cat("LaTeX tables can be generated by changing output format to 'latex'\n")
```

# Leave-One-Out Country Robustness Table

```{r loo-table}
loo_data <- results_het$loo_summary

note_loo <- "Leave-one-out robustness analysis for the non-military topics model. Each row shows results when excluding the specified country from the sample. Bandwidth is recalculated for each subset. Coefficient shown is for the running:treatment:csto interaction term. Standard errors clustered at source domain level."
note_loo_wrapped <- str_wrap(note_loo, width = 80)

loo_table <- loo_data %>%
  mutate(
    estimate_fmt = sprintf("%.3f%s", estimate,
                     case_when(p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                               p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
                               p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
                               TRUE ~ "")),
    std_error_fmt = sprintf("(%.3f)", std_error),
    p_value_fmt = sprintf("%.3f", p_value),
    n_obs_fmt = format(n_obs, big.mark = ","),
    bandwidth_fmt = sprintf("%.1f", bandwidth)
  ) %>%
  select(country_dropped, estimate_fmt, std_error_fmt, p_value_fmt, n_obs_fmt, bandwidth_fmt) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    country_dropped = "Country Dropped",
    estimate_fmt = "Coefficient",
    std_error_fmt = "Std. Error",
    p_value_fmt = "p-value",
    n_obs_fmt = "N",
    bandwidth_fmt = "Bandwidth"
  ) %>%
  tab_header(title = "Table A: Leave-One-Out Country Robustness Analysis",
             subtitle = "Non-Military Topics Model") %>%
  tab_footnote(footnote = note_loo_wrapped)

loo_table

gtsave(loo_table, file.path(FIGURES_TABLES, "table_loo_robustness.html"))
```

# Placebo Test Summary Table

```{r placebo-summary}
# Extract placebo results from all hypothesis results
# Note: H1 uses rdrobust, H2 and H3 use felm

# Extract rdrobust result for H1
placebo_h1 <- results_h1$model_placebo
h1_estimate <- placebo_h1$coef[1]  # Conventional RD estimate
h1_se <- placebo_h1$se[1]
h1_pval <- placebo_h1$pv[1]
h1_bw <- placebo_h1$bws[1, 1]
h1_n <- placebo_h1$N_h[1] + placebo_h1$N_h[2]

# Extract felm results for H2 and H3
placebo_h2 <- results_h2$model_placebo
placebo_h3 <- results_het$model_placebo_nonmil

h2_coef <- summary(placebo_h2)$coef["treatment", ]
h3_coef <- summary(placebo_h3)$coef["treatment", ]

# Create summary data frame
placebo_summary <- tibble(
  Model = c("(1) H1: Full Model (RDD)", "(2) H2: Diff-in-Disc", "(3) H3: Non-Military"),
  Estimate = c(h1_estimate, h2_coef["Estimate"], h3_coef["Estimate"]),
  Std_Error = c(h1_se, h2_coef["Cluster s.e."], h3_coef["Cluster s.e."]),
  p_value = c(h1_pval, h2_coef["Pr(>|t|)"], h3_coef["Pr(>|t|)"]),
  Bandwidth = c(h1_bw, results_h2$optimal_bw_placebo, results_het$optimal_bw_placebo_nonmil),
  N = c(h1_n, nobs(placebo_h2), nobs(placebo_h3))
)

note_placebo <- "Placebo tests using December 7, 2021 (Putin's announcement) as a false treatment date. Data restricted to pre-invasion period (before Feb 19, 2022). Model 1 uses rdrobust; Models 2-3 use felm with optimal bandwidth. Non-significant treatment effects suggest parallel trends assumption holds."
note_placebo_wrapped <- str_wrap(note_placebo, width = 80)

table_placebo <- placebo_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Estimate_fmt = sprintf("%.3f%s", Estimate,
                     case_when(p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                               p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
                               p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
                               TRUE ~ "")),
    Std_Error_fmt = sprintf("(%.3f)", Std_Error),
    p_value_fmt = sprintf("%.3f", p_value),
    Bandwidth_fmt = sprintf("%.1f", Bandwidth),
    N_fmt = format(N, big.mark = ",")
  ) %>%
  select(Model, Estimate_fmt, Std_Error_fmt, p_value_fmt, Bandwidth_fmt, N_fmt) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    Model = "Model",
    Estimate_fmt = "Estimate",
    Std_Error_fmt = "Std. Error",
    p_value_fmt = "p-value",
    Bandwidth_fmt = "Bandwidth",
    N_fmt = "N"
  ) %>%
  tab_header(title = "Table B: Placebo Test Summary (December 7, 2021)") %>%
  tab_footnote(footnote = note_placebo_wrapped)

table_placebo

gtsave(table_placebo, file.path(FIGURES_TABLES, "table_placebo_summary.html"))
```
